title: Common Tangent Loci of Three Convex Bodies
statement: For pairwise disjoint convex sets $A,B,C\subset\mathbb{R}^3$, let $S(A,B,C)$ be the points through which a line tangent to all three sets passes. Must $S(A,B,C)$ be contained in a measure-zero set?
